messages.subject: aroma-project.org
parts:
We have a new website:

http://www.aroma-project.org/

From now on, this should be your number one portal when looking for
information on any of the aroma.* packages. Note that we will keep
using the same mailing list (aroma-af...@googlegroups.com) - it
is only the documentation that have moved.

Cheers,

Henrik & co-developers
